title: Scalar actions for exceptional pro-etale operations
statement: For the fixed strict etale exceptional adjunction, site comparisons and pro-etale compact-support package, there are canonical coefficient scalar-action packages on the source and target pro-etale systems, and both exceptional composites carry derived scalar multiplication to the corresponding scalar component.

proof.text: Construct multiplication by the constant-ring sheafification image of r at every quotient level on an arbitrary site. Naturality of sheafification and of quotient maps makes this a natural endomorphism of strict systems. Descend the termwise endomorphism through quasi-isomorphism localization, with its explicit representative equation. Specialize this actual construction to the three pro-etale sites.

For every normalized geometric ordinary image, apply its moduleSMul graph equation to the underlying source module, the constant scalar map through the constant singleton, and the identity module operand. The constant singleton is already a sheaf. The constants normalization and moduleUnderlying identify scalar multiplication after inverse image. The inverseEvaluation isomorphisms then give this identity on entire strict systems, without assuming evaluation faithful on derived morphisms.

For an additive ordinary functor with its specified derived factorization, equality of scalar preservation follows after precomposing with Q from the representative equations, degreewise scalar preservation, and naturality of the factorization. Apply localization extensionality. Transfer preservation across an adjunction by the injective Hom bijection and naturality of the unit or counit. Apply these arguments to open inverse image and proper inverse image, then to their adjoints, and compose to obtain compact-support linearity.

Normalization uniquely determines each ordinary etale scalar endomorphism; the representative equation and localization extensionality uniquely determine its derived endomorphism. Hence the etale actions recorded in G agree with the same canonical construction. Apply geometric inverse-image scalar preservation to CX and CY, transfer it to the direct image of CY by adjunction, and combine this with G linearity and CX inverse-image linearity. This proves the transported right-functor equation for all objects.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Construction 4.1, Proposition 2.29(2), Construction 5.15 and Lemma 5.22; Stacks 04VG. F6 generalizes the proved private scalar construction of Sheaf.Paper.EtaleCompactSupportScalarAction to arbitrary sites and adds uniqueness to identify the etale actions in G. All ordinary, localization, adjunction and assembly arguments are complete Lean proofs.

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalProScalarActions : ∃ (scalarX : ExceptionalProScalarAction X O ell) (scalarY : ExceptionalProScalarAction Y O ell), (∀ r M, (exceptionalProSupport P).map ((scalarX.derived r).app M) = (scalarY.derived r).app ((exceptionalProSupport P).obj M)) ∧ (∀ r N, (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).map ((scalarY.derived r).app N) = (scalarX.derived r).app ((exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).obj N))
